name: Workforce Development Board of Contra Costa County
description: Free career counseling, job training, and employment services in Contra Costa County
fullDescription: Contra Costa County's America's Job Centers of California / EASTBAY Works career centers offer free employment services including career coaching, job training, and job search help.
whatTheyOffer:
- One-on-one career coaching and assessment
- Funding for job training, skills upgrades, and certifications
- On-the-job training opportunities
- Workshops on computer skills, networking, job search, resumes, and interviewing
- Services for young adults ages 16-24 with barriers to school or work
- Priority help for veterans, people with disabilities, low-income residents, and people with justice involvement
- Free online career training through SkillUp Contra Costa
- Self-service internet job search, phones, copiers, and fax
howToGetIt:
1. Contact the Workforce Development Board at 925-655-3800 or wdb@ehsd.cccounty.us
2. Or start online by choosing adult job seeker or job seeker age 16-24
3. Register and complete an assessment
4. Work with a career coach
5. Access training and employment services
keywords: Contra Costa, workforce, AJCC, America's Job Center, EASTBAY Works, job training, career services, Richmond, Concord, Antioch
